From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observed heartbeat gaps for tenant prod-orp, asking for downtime determination

Markus / Laura — initial telemetry pull attached. Summary:
- Between 08:41:12 and 08:59:48 PST we observed 3 brief node heartbeat misses across two instances serving prod-orp (instance ids: grv-12, grv-15).
- Root cause indicators: transient RPC timeouts to the KV-backed metadata store while compaction was running on the shard. Compaction increased IO latency for ~17m.
- Impact: request pacing caused queued tokens to stall for those requests; we see a small spike in 504s and increased generator latency in traces.

Attachments: orbipay-uptime-sample-logs.zip (we included spans and node logs), kibana-heartbeat-screenshot.png

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) Mark the window 2026-12-07T08:41:12-08:59:48 as 'service-affecting' in the internal incident ticket for OrbiPay pending root-cause confirmation.
2) Confirm whether the observed behavior qualifies as an SLA breach under the 'availability' clause (>= 99.9% monthly) after we normalize for tenant traffic weighting.
3) If yes, produce a pro-rata credit calculation and schedule a postmortem within 5 business days.

I'll run a second pass for any orchestration or autoscaler hints; early signal looks like a compaction-induced IO tail.

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
SRE — Redwood Inference
